accents.$description: The accent axis, dark resolution. Six user-selectable accents drawn straight from the Tailwind v4 palette: --accent is a FILL and must carry --on-accent at >=4.5; --accent-2 is TEXT and must clear 4.5 on --bg. That is why the fills are not one ramp step: indigo, teal, green and amber sit at -500, blue and rose at -600. Teal, green and amber take dark ink because those hues are intrinsically light at -500 and darkening them to carry white ink would read as muddy on a near-black ground; blue and rose darken instead, which is what every system does with blue. Indigo is the default. On the desktop these become :root[data-accent="…"] blocks and feed shadcn's `primary` / `ring` / `sidebar-primary` slots, so choosing an accent re-tints every stock component with no per-component override.

accent-2.$description: The text-safe accent step. --accent is a fill (indigo-500 measures 4.37 as text on --bg and misses AA); this is what accent-coloured TEXT uses.

blue.$description: Fill blue-600, text blue-400. Blue is one of two accents whose -500 step does not carry white ink in dark (3.71); -600 measures 5.26 and still clears 3:1 as a focus ring at 3.78.

on-accent.$description: Dark ink: the teal fill is too light to carry white text at AA.
Dark ink: the green fill is too light to carry white text at AA.
Dark ink: the amber fill is too light to carry white text at AA.

rose.$description: Fill rose-600, text rose-400. rose-500 measures 3.73 with white ink; rose-600 measures 4.78, ring 4.16.

accent.$description: The active accent. Defaults to indigo; the [data-accent] blocks override it.

accent-2.$description: The text-safe accent step: lighter than --accent in dark, darker in light. --accent is a fill and is not guaranteed to clear 4.5 as text.
